## History

Harmon Andrews is a resident of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). His property was among those that suffered damage when a severe hailstorm hit the town on the exact day [Uncle Abe](../character/uncle-abe.md) had predicted.

_Sources: [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P3](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0003), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P24](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0024), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P43](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0043)_
